declarations.type:
∀ {MembershipDigest PolicyDigest : Type}
  (system : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinJointConfiguration.ReconfigurationSystem)
  (ledger :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConfigurationIdentity.IdentityVoteLedger system MembershipDigest
      PolicyDigest)
  (certificate :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConfigurationIdentity.IdentityBoundJointCertificate system
      MembershipDigest PolicyDigest)
  (node : system.Node),
  node ∈ certificate.oldSigners →
    ledger node certificate.identity certificate.term certificate.index ≠ some certificate.receipt →
      ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConfigurationIdentity.IdentityBoundJointCertificateValid system
          ledger certificate
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConfigurationIdentity.vote_from_other_configuration_cannot_validate_certificate

declarations.type:
∀ {MembershipDigest PolicyDigest : Type}
  (system : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinJointConfiguration.ReconfigurationSystem)
  (ledger :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConfigurationIdentity.IdentityVoteLedger system MembershipDigest
      PolicyDigest)
  (left right :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConfigurationIdentity.IdentityBoundJointCertificate system
      MembershipDigest PolicyDigest),
  left.identity = right.identity →
    left.term = right.term →
      left.index = right.index →
        ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConfigurationIdentity.IdentityBoundJointCertificateValid system
            ledger left →
          ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConfigurationIdentity.IdentityBoundJointCertificateValid system
              ledger right →
            left.receipt = right.receipt
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConfigurationIdentity.valid_same_configuration_certificates_bind_same_receipt
